documents.text: Newton second law states that net force equals mass multiplied by acceleration. In SI notation F = m a and force is measured in newtons.
documents.title: Net force

documents.text: Ignoring air resistance, a projectile has constant horizontal velocity while gravity produces downward acceleration. Launch angle and speed affect range.
documents.title: Projectile motion

documents.text: Kinetic energy is one half of mass times velocity squared. Doubling velocity increases kinetic energy by a factor of four.
documents.title: Kinetic energy

documents.text: Conduction transfers heat through material contact, convection transfers heat with moving fluid, and radiation transfers energy by electromagnetic waves.
documents.title: Heat transfer

documents.text: Ohm law relates voltage, current, and resistance: V = I R. A series circuit carries the same current through each component.
documents.title: Electric circuits

documents.text: Wave speed equals frequency times wavelength. Higher frequency means more oscillations per second when wave speed is fixed.
documents.title: Wave frequency

documents.text: Friction opposes relative motion between surfaces. Kinetic friction is often modeled as coefficient times normal force.
documents.title: Friction

documents.text: Pressure is force divided by area. In a static fluid, pressure increases with depth according to density, gravity, and height.
documents.title: Fluid pressure

documents.text: A derivative measures instantaneous rate of change. The derivative of position with respect to time is velocity.
documents.title: Derivative

documents.text: A definite integral accumulates quantity over an interval. The area under a velocity versus time graph gives displacement.
documents.title: Integral

documents.text: A matrix can represent a linear transformation. Multiplying a vector by a rotation matrix changes its coordinates while preserving length.
documents.title: Matrix transformation

documents.text: For independent events, the probability that both occur is the product of their probabilities. A probability ranges from zero to one.
documents.title: Probability

documents.text: An eigenvector keeps its direction under a linear transformation, and its eigenvalue gives the scale factor applied to that vector.
documents.title: Eigenvalues

documents.text: Optimization selects input values that minimize or maximize an objective subject to constraints. Gradient methods use local derivatives.
documents.title: Optimization

documents.text: Independent measurement uncertainties combine through the sensitivity of a result to each input. Reporting units and uncertainty is essential.
documents.title: Uncertainty propagation

documents.text: A Fourier transform represents a signal by frequency components. Filtering can attenuate high-frequency noise while retaining a lower-frequency trend.
documents.title: Fourier components

documents.text: A loaded beam experiences bending moment and shear force. Support conditions and cross section determine deflection under a specified load.
documents.title: Beam load

documents.text: Repeated stress can initiate and grow cracks below the static yield strength. Fatigue life depends on stress amplitude and cycle count.
documents.title: Fatigue cycles

documents.text: A feedback controller compares a measured output with a setpoint and adjusts an actuator to reduce error. Excess gain can cause oscillation.
documents.title: Feedback control

documents.text: Calibration relates a sensor signal to a reference quantity. A calibration record should include offset, slope, units, and uncertainty.
documents.title: Sensor calibration

documents.text: A low-pass filter suppresses rapid fluctuations above a cutoff frequency. Filter choice trades noise reduction against response delay.
documents.title: Signal filtering

documents.text: A pump moves fluid by adding pressure head. Flow rate depends on the pump curve, pipe resistance, and fluid properties.
documents.title: Pump flow

documents.text: Yield strength is the stress at which permanent deformation begins. Engineering stress is force divided by the original cross-sectional area.
documents.title: Material yield

documents.text: A heat exchanger transfers thermal energy between fluids separated by a wall. Temperature difference and surface area influence heat-transfer rate.
documents.title: Heat exchanger

documents.text: A cell membrane is selectively permeable and regulates movement of water, ions, and molecules between the cell and its environment.
documents.title: Cell membrane

documents.text: Enzymes lower activation energy and can speed biochemical reactions. Reaction rate can level off when enzyme active sites are saturated.
documents.title: Enzyme rate

documents.text: DNA replication copies genetic information using complementary base pairing. Each original strand can serve as a template for a new strand.
documents.title: DNA replication

documents.text: Photosynthesis uses light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into chemical energy stored in sugars, releasing oxygen.
documents.title: Photosynthesis

documents.text: Incidence counts new cases in a population over time, while prevalence counts all existing cases at a specified time.
documents.title: Epidemiology

documents.text: The ideal gas law is P V = n R T. At constant amount of gas, pressure and volume vary inversely when temperature is fixed.
documents.title: Ideal gas

documents.text: A solution with lower pH has a greater hydrogen ion concentration. Buffers resist large pH changes when small amounts of acid or base are added.
documents.title: Acid and base

documents.text: Reaction rate depends on concentration, temperature, surface area, and catalysts. A catalyst changes rate without being consumed overall.
documents.title: Reaction rate

documents.text: Spectroscopy measures how matter absorbs, emits, or scatters light. A spectrum can identify chemical composition through characteristic features.
documents.title: Spectroscopy

documents.text: Evaporation changes liquid water into vapor, condensation forms liquid droplets, and precipitation returns water from clouds to the surface.
documents.title: Water cycle

documents.text: Carbon moves among atmosphere, oceans, organisms, and rocks. Photosynthesis removes carbon dioxide from air while respiration releases it.
documents.title: Carbon cycle

documents.text: 화성의 대기는 매우 얇고 대부분 이산화탄소로 이루어져 있다. 표면 기압은 지구보다 훨씬 낮다.
documents.title: 화성의 대기

documents.text: P waves are compressional seismic waves and usually travel faster than S waves. S waves do not travel through liquid outer core.
documents.title: Seismic waves

documents.text: Binary search repeatedly halves a sorted search interval. Its time complexity grows logarithmically with the number of elements.
documents.title: Binary search

documents.text: Dijkstra algorithm finds shortest paths with nonnegative edge weights by repeatedly selecting the unsettled node with smallest tentative distance.
documents.title: Shortest path

documents.text: Numerical algorithms can magnify rounding error. Stable formulations avoid subtracting nearly equal floating-point numbers when possible.
documents.title: Numerical stability

documents.text: A photovoltaic cell converts light into electrical energy. Its output depends on illumination, temperature, and electrical load.
documents.title: Solar cell

documents.text: Battery capacity is commonly expressed in ampere-hours. Internal resistance causes voltage drop under load and generates heat.
documents.title: Battery capacity

documents.text: The newton is the SI unit of force, the pascal is the SI unit of pressure, and the kelvin is an SI unit for thermodynamic temperature.
documents.title: SI units

documents.text: A transit occurs when a planet passes in front of its star. The measured brightness dips slightly and can reveal planet size and orbit.
documents.title: Exoplanet transit

documents.text: A statistical hypothesis test compares observed data with a null model. A p value is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true.
documents.title: Hypothesis test
